encodings.note: Wake up the responding logical processors from the SENTER sleep state.

exceptions.when: If CR4.SMXE = 0. If GETSEC[WAKEUP] is not reported as supported by GETSEC[CAPABILITIES].
If CR0.PE = 0 or CPL > 0 or EFLAGS.VM = 1. If in VMX operation. If a protected partition is not already active or the processor is currently in authenticated code mode. If the processor is in SMM.
If CR4.SMXE = 0. If GETSEC[WAKEUP] is not reported as supported by GETSEC[CAPABILITIES].
GETSEC[WAKEUP] is not recognized in real-address mode.
If CR4.SMXE = 0. If GETSEC[WAKEUP] is not reported as supported by GETSEC[CAPABILITIES].
GETSEC[WAKEUP] is not recognized in virtual-8086 mode.
